title: Custom VTX card label is overwritten
observed: In the native custom-frequency fixture, CUSTOM measures98px at x15. Its card spans x8–82; the next card starts x87 and paints over the text. This is reproduced clipping, not a general impression.
remedy: Use the frequency as the primary label when no standard channel exists; fit or wrap secondary text to a measured content box.

title: Arming title has no right gutter
observed: Accelerometer not calibrated measures313px at x159, ending at x472, the panel edge. It fits in the inspected native runtime; it is not proven clipped.
remedy: Reserve an8px inner gutter and wrap the title by measured width, rather than shrinking every title.

title: Read-only setup lists still offer editing actions
observed: VTX category8 contains four informational rows, including NOT IMPLEMENTED, but uses selection/edit styling and presents minus, plus, Save and Revert. Application category12 is mostly notes but its MSP control really works.
remedy: Render notes as status/help. Offer edit/commit controls only for editable items and show their scope. Do not remove the working MSP Off action.

title: Shell and page renderers both own the same header space
observed: Legacy page headers/status are drawn before the shell covers them. Examples include Sensor Inspector source count and prior live-data badges. This is actual render composition overlap, even where the final screenshot looks tidy.
remedy: Let the shell own header/footer rectangles; render each needed status exactly once in an assigned body region.

title: Graphs show samples without usable scales
observed: Power and RC Link traces show a sample count but no time axis, numerical scale or min/max. Voltage uses a zero-based pack-dependent range and current a fixed0–100A range, so small changes can look flat.
remedy: Show units, latest/min/max and a defined time window; use stable bounded scales with gaps for missing data.

title: Technical values change meaning across views
observed: Telemetry converts attitude to degrees; Sensor Inspector displays raw0.19/0.49 radians without units. RFMD3 and DOWN99% are not explained. GPS Details accurately refuses to invent a fix, but the long unavailable message occupies the small satellite summary.
remedy: Use shared value formatting and source identity, decode RF captions only with known protocol/version, and place compact unavailable labels with detail on selection.

title: Fixed metadata is styled as a command
observed: Track NORTH UP is drawn like adjacent enabled buttons, but no handler covers it. The LIVE SENSORS button refreshes binding metadata and has no confirmation; it does not change live/demo mode.
remedy: Draw North up as plot metadata. Name refresh by what it does and acknowledge completion.

title: Space is allocated to repeated status and navigation
observed: Top bar34px + context26px + footer26px =86/272px (31.6%). The shared main content is180px high. Flight repeats link and pack readings in sidebars/footer. The size alone is not a defect; redundant content must earn its space.
remedy: Preserve cockpit geometry initially. Remove redundant navigation before shrinking targets or instrument art; reuse a single stable status/alert presentation.
